path.description: Path to the source JSONL dataset.
path.title: Path

seed.description: Seed for the deterministic hash/shuffle assignment. Same dataset + seed always reproduces the identical split.
seed.title: Seed

train_ratio.description: Fraction of rows/groups assigned to train.
train_ratio.title: Train Ratio

val_ratio.description: Fraction of rows/groups assigned to val.
val_ratio.title: Val Ratio

test_ratio.description: Fraction assigned to test. 0 (default) omits test.jsonl entirely — SFT convention is train + a small held-out val for loss monitoring; a dedicated benchmark eval-gate covers what a classic test split would, so test is opt-in, not the classic 70/15/15 default.
test_ratio.title: Test Ratio

group_by.description: Row field (e.g. a doc/source id) whose value must never span two splits — every row sharing this field's value is assigned to the SAME split. None means every row is its own group (no grouping).
group_by.title: Group By

stratify_by.description: Row field whose value distribution should be balanced across splits (e.g. source/task/language).
stratify_by.title: Stratify By

backend.description: 'auto' (sklearn if installed and useful, else hash) | 'hash' (pure-stdlib, always available) | 'sklearn' (StratifiedShuffleSplit/GroupShuffleSplit/StratifiedGroupKFold, needs the [split] extra).
backend.title: Backend

shard_size.description: Rows per output shard (#891). 0 (default) writes ONE <split>.jsonl per split — the back-compatible shape. >0 rolls to <split>.00001.jsonl … every shard_size rows so a >>RAM split lands as many bounded files a downstream reader can stream/parallelize. Only the streaming hash backend shards; the sklearn (materialized) path always writes one file.
shard_size.title: Shard Size

register_as.description: #2020 (ADR-0102 D1) — register each split as a FROZEN CHILD VERSION of this dataset name: '<register_as>-train' (role training), '-val' (validation) and '-test' (test), each with its own content hash, lineage back to the parent version, and the declared split policy on the record. Empty (default) writes files only, exactly as before. Items never move: a re-split under a different policy mints NEW children and leaves the old ones byte-identical at their old version numbers.
register_as.title: Register As

parent_ref.description: The parent's 'dataset:<name>@<version>' ref, recorded as the children's parent_version and the source of their inherited schema / column mapping. Empty resolves the head version of `register_as` when one exists.
parent_ref.title: Parent Ref
